The live application below is running completely client-side in your browser using serverless **Shinylive** (WebAssembly). You can interactively step through simulation events (+1, +10, +100 steps), toggle species visibility (`Host`, `Parasite`), switch between **Overlay (1 Map)** and **Separate (Adjacent Maps)** view modes, and inspect organism positions on hexagonal substrate overlays.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source("shinylive_helpers.R")
render_standalone_app("hexmoveApp", height = 850)
```

---

## Programmatic Application Usage

Launch the interactive application natively in R:

```r
library(ewing)

hexmoveApp()
```
